# app2smile Bilibili scripts

`Scripts/Surge/BilibiliAdJSON.js` and `Scripts/Surge/BilibiliAdProto.js` are
unmodified snapshots from [app2smile/rules](https://github.com/app2smile/rules),
respectively `js/bilibili-json.js` and `js/bilibili-proto.js` on its `master`
branch, downloaded on 2026-09-27. The upstream repository is licensed under
MIT; its license notice is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.

This repository hosts those scripts so the installed Surge module does not
depend on remote script URLs from the removed `deezertidal/private/js-backup`
tree. Changes upstream are not synchronized automatically. The upstream
module is `module/bilibili.sgmodule`; its URL patterns were adapted for this
repository's module.
